titleStmt.title: Kephalaia of the Teacher, edition page 27: diplomatic and Leiden transcription

sourceDesc.bibl: Kephalaia (Manichäische Handschriften der Staatlichen Museen Berlin), ed. H. J. Polotsky and A. Böhlig, Stuttgart: Kohlhammer, 27. Restorations, sublinear dots, gap counts and corrections are the editors'.

encodingDesc.p: EpiDoc. Read by eye from the page image; gap counts, sublinear dots and supralinear stroke extents verified by measurement on the image. A supralinear stroke is marked on every letter it covers by at least half its width. Spaces are the edition's word division. Facsimile zones are measured line centres. The editors' German statements are not transcribed: each is mapped to an id of the controlled vocabulary data/kephalaia/editorial_vocabulary.json and carried as @ana (ed: statements in the text, app: apparatus footnotes, tr: categories of the transcriber's commentary).

div.p: The framed manuscript page number [ⲕⲍ] is printed with a bar above and below as the frame, not as a supralinear stroke. The edition prints an apostrophe after ⲧ of [ϩⲁⲩ]ⲧ (a separate mark above the line, x ≈ 627); the reading markup has no sign for it, so it is recorded only in this note. Measured stroke over ⲛⲛ of ⲛⲛϭⲁⲙ (1184–1203): ⲛ 57 %, ⲛ 53 %, encoded on both.
The stroke over ϩ of ⲉⲩⲟⲩⲁⲛϩ is printed obliquely. Measured stroke over ⲙ of ⲁϫⲙ (815–828).
Measured stroke over ⲙⲛ (687–708): ⲙ 55 %, ⲛ 50 %, encoded on both. Measured stroke over ϩⲛ of ⲁϩⲛ (918–937): ϩ 43 %, ⲛ 50 %; encoded on ⲛ only.
ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ: separate sublinear dots under ⲏ and under ⲣ; the dot under ⲣ stands just right of the stem (7× zoom).
The bracket opened before the first three dots is not closed in the edition; it is closed here after the dots, since ⲟ̣ⲩϣⲏ̣ carries sublinear dots as read text.
The ϣ of ⲛⲟⲩϣⲏ before ⲉⲧϩⲛ has a separate sublinear dot in its lower bowl (7× zoom; the ϣ of ⲟⲩϣⲏ earlier in the line has none). All other ϣ on the page were checked at 5–6× and carry no dot.
The edition prints a question mark after ⲉⲧⲧⲏⲧ inside the brackets [ⲥⲙⲟⲥ ⲉⲧⲧⲏⲧ? ⲡⲥⲁ]; encoded as two adjoining restorations, the first with low certainty.
An enlarged ⲧ begins ⲧⲙⲁϩϥⲧⲟⲉ after the bracketed gap.
Measured stroke over ⲙⲛ (656–676): ⲙ 52 %, ⲛ 64 %, encoded on both.
The stroke over ϩ of [ⲁ]ⲛϩ is printed obliquely.
Measured stroke over ϩⲛ (1058–1077): ϩ 36 %, ⲛ 57 %; encoded on ⲛ only.
Lines 21–23 are 32 dots each, without brackets.
Measured stroke over ⲙⲛ (1133–1153): ⲙ 50 %, ⲛ 53 %, encoded on both.
The eleventh dot (x ≈ 806) is faint and breaks into two specks (area 4 and 2) but is clear in both overlapping 4× strips.
Measured stroke over ⲛⲛ of ⲛⲛⲟⲩⲉⲣⲏⲩ (1065–1084): 53 % on each ⲛ, encoded on both.
Measured stroke over ⲛⲛ of ⲛⲛϩⲟⲟⲩⲉ (1110–1129): ⲛ 53 %, ⲛ 60 %, encoded on both.

Line in ekthesis with an enlarged ⲛ inside the restoration. Measured strokes over ⲛϥ of ⲛϥⲩⲡⲁⲣⲭⲟⲩ (915–933; ⲛ 57 %, ϥ 54 %) and over the final ⲛϥ (1163–1186; ⲛ 86 %, ϥ 54 %); the final ϥ has a sublinear dot left of its descender.
